text: 67 The Elephant and the Ants 4.5 Once upon a time, there lived a huge elephant in the forest. Everyday, it would walk heavily stomping the anthills. The ants decided to teach the elephant a lesson. One day, the elephant was eating banana leaves. All the ants started biting it. The elephant was unable to bear the pain. It began to trumpet loudly. The ants felt sorry for the elephant. They said, ‘‘We are sorry. We wanted to teach you a lesson.’’ The elephant realised its mistake. It understood that all living beings feel pain. From that day onwards the elephant did not trouble others. Moral : Might does not always make right. 1. Read aloud.
